subject: Discovery follow-up: Springwell embedding/streaming fit & SDK changes

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@springwell.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: Springwell embedding/streaming fit & SDK changes

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned. High-level notes:

Pain points you shared:
- Search relevance drifts for long-form clinical notes (50–5k tokens); current vector store batching is slow and expensive.
- Need low-tail latency for triage use cases (p95 < 200ms) when running reranker + generated summary.
- Hard requirement around structured output for diagnoses (JSON schema) so downstream systems can ingest.

Goals you outlined:
- Replace current embed + ANN pipeline with an integrated rerank + streaming summary that outputs a validated JSON payload.
- Keep monthly inference spend <= $X (we discussed ballpark).
- Start a 6–8 week pilot with test data and weekly checkpoints.

Product/fit items we discussed:
- Embeddings + sparse rerank on Redwood Dedicated / private deployment for data isolation.
- Streaming function-calls for structured JSON outputs; support for incremental token flush so UI shows partial summaries.
- SDK change: you'd need a small client-side helper to adapt your annotation pipeline to our new batched embed endpoint (we sketched 2 API calls instead of 4).

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll send over the security questionnaire items you flagged + a short architecture sketch (attached).
2) Karthik (cc’d) to do a 60-minute technical deep-dive next week to validate perf targets (p95) and KV cache behavior.
3) If the tech check looks good, we spin up a pilot on Dedicated with a 2-week smoke test and agreed eval prompts.

Could you confirm the pilot start target (you mentioned early July) and the people who should join the tech call?

Attachments: postcall-architecture-sketch.png (1 file)

Thanks —
Ben Carter

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Discovery follow-up: Springwell embedding/streaming fit & SDK changes

Thanks for the roundup — reviewed the SOC2 PDF and the sketch. Quick notes: 

- Isolation: Private deployment (VPC) is the safer recommendation if they require contractual data residency. Dedicated could work if they accept controls around network egress and if we can surface audit logs; I’ll enumerate differences in the tech call.
- Latency/throughput: streaming + rerank with KV cache should meet p95 < 200ms for short contexts (<=512 tokens). For long-form (3–5k tokens) we should propose a hybrid approach: partial dense retrieval (first-pass embeddings on chunked windows) + on-device rerank with early cutoff to keep latency in check.
- SDK changes: low-lift. We can provide an updated client helper that does batched embeddings and handles chunking + anchor metadata. No need for customer to run proxy. I’ll prepare a short code snippet and perf estimate for the June 1 call.

I’m available June 2 and June 4 afternoons PT. Marissa, can you share the pilot success checklist draft by Monday so we have it for the kickoff?

— Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
